product_metadata.title: Amcomfy Thick Kitchen Mat, Anti Fatigue Non Slip Comfort Floor Mats Ergonomic Design Standing Desk mat for House Sink Garage Office Laundry (Black, 17.3" x28"-0.47")
features: Ultimate Comfort: Amconfy anti-fatigue mats provide cushioning support and improved comfort while standing. Effectively reduces the stress on your feet, knees and lower back when standing all day at the kitchen sink or in the office.

Accredited for Safety:Ergonomic design Anti Fatigue Kitchen Mat , 0.47 inch thick with Non-slip bottom. More safe and More comfort.Non-slip bottom layer keeps it in place on a hardwood floor, tile floor.

Anti-Fatigue: This kitchen mat encourages good posture and helps alleviates stress in pressure points around the body with 0.47" thickness. This perfectly cushioned mat is made from 100% high-quality material and helps you to comfortably stand for long periods.

Waterproof Surface: Amcomfy anti fatigue mat with stain-resistant and waterproof surface, easily wipe off any spills with damp cloth. BUYER NOTE: Water under the anti-fatigue mat may cause slippage and the carpet must be placed on a dry surface during use.
Warranty: We stand behind all of our products. Any qulity issues or other concerns, we offer full money back guarantee.
Tips:If the mat you receive has creases due to transportation, please lay it flat for 1~2 days to remove the creases on the carpet before using it for the first time, or wash and dry the kitchen mat.

Used for any area at home, such as kitchen, office, workstation, laundry room, dressing table, etc. Ergonomic design with 0.47 inch thick and non-slip design makes it more comfort to stand for long periods of time while washing dishes, cooking, cleaning, etc.
